capabilities: Copy or save rendered diagrams as SVG or PNG
Export every diagram in the active note to the vault at once
Copy the Mermaid source or save it as a Markdown note
Configure export appearance, PNG scale, and save folder
Add an export button and right-click menu on rendered diagrams
extras: The README notes the plugin runs fully offline and the clipboard is only used for the explicitly exported diagram; manual installation is required. It carries an unreviewed-plugin notice.
problem: Mermaid diagrams only render inside Obsidian, so there is no built-in way to get them out as standalone images for use elsewhere.
summary: Exports rendered Mermaid diagrams from notes as SVG or PNG, via copy to clipboard, saving to disk, or batch-saving all diagrams in a note.
